core.name: Core
core.description: Planning, verification, debugging, review, handoff and project memory.
core.impact: Generated roles and on-demand skills only; no code execution.

web.name: Web
web.description: Client, server, API, database, accessibility and integration work.
optional_dependencies: Project's existing UI and integration test tools
web.impact: Adds canonical specialists; installs no runtime dependencies.

python.name: Python
python.description: Python services, packaging, pytest, typing, debugging and measured performance through existing specialist roles.
python.impact: Role selection only; optional tools are not installed.

ai-ml.name: AI/ML
ai-ml.description: Model integrations, retrieval, data pipelines, evaluation and inference reliability.
ai-ml.impact: No inference, model download or provider calls at installation.

security.name: Security
security.description: Threat modeling, secure coding, dependencies, secrets and authorization review.
security.impact: Read-only reviewers; runtime permissions remain provider-controlled.

devops.name: DevOps/Release
devops.description: CI, containers, configuration, observability, readiness and release verification.

documentation.name: Documentation
documentation.description: Project explanations, evidence-backed diagrams, walkthroughs and memory synchronization.
documentation.impact: Portable Markdown and Mermaid; deep regeneration remains explicit.
